Installation

Source: vignettes/installation.Rmd
installation.Rmd

Requirements

  • R >= 4.3
  • For enrichment: enrichR (suggested); optionally clusterProfiler / org.Hs.eg.db
  • Composition heatmaps use Bioconductor ComplexHeatmap / circlize (Imports)

Install from GitHub 

install.packages("devtools")
devtools::install_github("mongi126/Sphinx")

Install from source tarball 

install.packages("Sphinx_1.0.1.tar.gz", repos = NULL, type = "source")

Load and check 

library(Sphinx)
packageVersion("Sphinx")
help(package = "Sphinx")

Example data in the docs

Tutorials use reg055_A from Schurch et al. CODEX imaging (schurch2020coordinated):

  • Technology: CODEX
  • ~3,887 cells, 58 protein channels
  • Coordinates in obsm/spatial
  • Published labels in obs/ClusterName

Any table with Cell_ID, X, Y, and a categorical annotation column works the same way.
